verdict.rationale: The evidence confirms vLLM ships an OpenAI-compatible API server (vllm-docs-9, vllm-docs-15) but nowhere in the pack is there mention of a downloadable OpenAPI/swagger spec file or endpoint (e.g., /openapi.json) being documented or referenced; the probe even shows a 404 on llms.txt, and no other spec-download evidence is given.
